domain_name.description: Local domain name (e.g., 'lan') to append to unqualified hostnames. If not set, domain-less queries won’t be expanded.

upstream_servers.description: List of upstream DNS servers to forward queries to (IP addresses or hostnames).

items.description: IP address or resolvable hostname of an upstream DNS server.

listen_interfaces.description: List of network interfaces (e.g., ['eth0', 'br0']) to bind to. If omitted, defaults to binding only to 127.0.0.1 for security.

addn_hosts.description: Path to an additional hosts file (e.g., '/etc/dnsmasq/hosts') to append to the in-memory host table.

expand_hosts.description: Whether to automatically append the local-domain to unqualified names in /etc/hosts and static-hosts entries.

cache_size.description: Size of the DNS cache (number of records). Set to 0 to disable caching.

log_level.description: Log verbosity level (0 = quiet, 1 = basic queries, 2–7 = more verbose). Also controls logging of DHCP queries.

log_file.description: Log file path. Use '-' to log to syslog, or '/var/log/dnsmasq.log' for a file.

dns_port.description: Port on which dnsmasq listens for DNS queries.

dhcp_enabled.description: Enable or disable DHCP server functionality.

dhcp_networks.description: List of DHCP ranges (subnets). Each defines a range and interface for DHCP assignment.

interface.description: Network interface (e.g., 'eth0') to serve DHCP on.

start.description: First IP address in the range (e.g., '192.168.1.100').

end.description: Last IP address in the range (e.g., '192.168.1.200').

dhcp_options.description: List of custom DHCP options (e.g., boot parameters).

code.description: Option code (e.g., '66' for TFTP server, or '175' for vendor-encapsulated).

dhcp_gateway.description: Gateway IP to assign to DHCP clients (DHCP option 3). If omitted, no gateway is set.

dhcp_dns.description: List of DNS server IPs to assign to DHCP clients (DHCP option 6). Defaults to dnsmasq’s own address if omitted.

items.description: IP address of a DNS server (e.g., '192.168.1.1').

static_hosts.description: List of static DHCP leases and DNS mappings (by MAC, IP, and/or hostname).

mac.description: Client MAC address (e.g., 'aa:bb:cc:dd:ee:ff'). Required for DHCP reservation.

ip.description: Static IP address to assign (e.g., '192.168.1.50'). Required for static DNS mapping.

name.description: Hostname to map to the MAC/IP. Used for DNS resolution.

hostname.description: Alternative hostname (if different from 'name'). Rarely needed.

dhcp_port.description: Port on which dnsmasq listens for DHCP traffic. Typically left at 67.

ignore_hosts.description: Whether to ignore entries in /etc/hosts for DHCP (only use static_hosts). Prevents accidental overrides.
